body: OWNER ACCEPTANCE UPDATE — current 76c62e7 quickstart is a real improvement but still reads as extremely thin for a library of this size. Measured cause: the site already contains eight exact executable programs with captured outputs and four data-derived static figures, but scala/getting-started presents only the alignment workflow; the other capabilities are relegated to a bottom link list. Treat this as discoverability and product-explanation debt, not an invitation to invent capabilities. A successor should front-load a visual capability tour answering what does this library do: source atlas; story/proposition/context model; recall graph; feature/embedding batch; GraphHsmm alignment and uncertainty; support-aware RecallSignature; Autobiographical Interview scoring; canonical codec/output delivery. For each, show one concrete input, the central public API call, the exact output shape, and a link to the full runnable example; reuse the already receipted sources/outputs/figures. Include explicit current boundary: complete arbitrary-prose model construction and calibrated provider runtime are not yet delivered. Do not retroactively block approved cand-7693 on this later owner finding, and do not claim code-red product progress from styling alone; carry it as the next documentation content requirement.
